Usage:
  zplcore serve [--port 9100] [--any] [--out dir] [--dpi n] [-f png|pdf] [--chaos script.json] [--cut-marks] [--rfid]
                [--concurrent] [--profile ZD421d-203] [--option cutter,peeler,rfid,...]

  --port n         TCP port (default 9100, 0 = any free port)
  --any            listen on all interfaces (default: loopback only)
  --out dir        save every printed label there
  --dpi n          resolution (default 203)
  -f png|pdf       image format of saved labels (default png)
  --chaos file     JSON chaos script: printer options and scheduled faults, e.g.
                   {"seed":42,"printer":{"cutter":true,"labelPrintTimeMs":200,"honorPauseCount":true},
                    "faults":[{"kind":"paperOut","after":{"labels":3},"clearAfterMs":5000},
                              {"kind":"latency","delayMs":300},{"kind":"disconnect","after":{"bytes":1000}}]}
  --cut-marks      draw cut markers below each saved label
  --rfid           simulate RFID tags: ^RF writes/reads, read-back, locks, ^HV answers, VOID on encode errors
  --concurrent     process all connections in parallel (load tests). Default: like a Zebra printer, connections
                   are accepted together but served one at a time, first come first served; a connection with
                   an incomplete format (^XA without ^XZ) keeps the others waiting
  --profile id     behave like that printer model (zplcore twin list): dpi, printhead width, cutter,
                   memory, ~HI and SGD identity answers
  --option list    installed options of the profile (cutter, peeler, rewinder, rfid, linerless, applicator, clock)

Fault kinds: paperOut ribbonOut headOpen headOverTemperature motorOverTemperature cutterFault pause
headUnderTemperature corruptRam paperNearEnd cleanPrinthead replacePrinthead bufferFull outOfMemory rfidVoid
dropLabels disconnect communicationTimeout latency slowReceive partialWrites powerOff.
Triggers: "after": {"labels"|"bytes"|"cuts"|"
